seoTitle: Browser Console Log Cleaner: Strip Noise and Group Repeats
metaDescription: Clean pasted DevTools console output: remove file:line prefixes, drop dev-server noise and collapse repeated messages. Free.
intro: Strips source links and known noise from copied console output and counts repeats.
why:
Copying the console gives lines with file:line prefixes, VM numbers and dev-server chatter. Cleaning them makes the output fit for a bug report.

The noise list is short and shown in the result: React DevTools hint, source-map warnings, vite, HMR, webpack-dev-server, Violation and third-party cookie notices. Indented stack lines are kept.
howTo: Copy the console output and paste it.
